<!--- Title format: [type](scope): description -->
<!--- Types: feat, fix, improve, hotfix, chore, docs, test — add ! for breaking changes -->

## What?
<!--- 1–5 bullets: what was added, changed, or fixed. Stick to implemented facts. -->

## Why?
<!--- Required even for minor fixes. What problem does this solve? -->

## How?
<!--- How to test this change. Do not invent scenarios not present in the diff. -->

## Types of changes
<!--- Check all that apply, remove others -->
- [ ] feat (new feature)
- [ ] fix (bug fix)
- [ ] improve (enhancement to existing functionality)
- [ ] hotfix (urgent production fix)
- [ ] chore (dependencies, tooling, config)
- [ ] docs
- [ ] test
